Siena enters 0-5 with defensive woes allowing 85+ points per game, while Duke boasts a 5-0 record and averages 20-point margins in early wins. No major injuries reported for Duke's key rotation players per official updates, cementing expectations of a blowout. Realistic upset risks remain slim but include unforeseen foul trouble, turnover spikes, or Siena's unproven shooters erupting from deep—echoing rare Cinderella shocks in non-conference tilts.
